features.heading: What you can do with Background Remover
features.intro: A focused cutout workflow with clear credit and storage boundaries.

items.title: Create a cutout and choose its background
items.description: Remove the image background with cloud AI. Then keep the result transparent or select a solid background color before saving the PNG.

items.title: Use AI with a visible credit cost
items.description: The selected image is uploaded privately for AI processing. One AI credit is reserved when the job begins; failed processing refunds the reservation.

steps.heading: How to use Background Remover
steps.intro: From your source file to a result you can save, in three steps.

items.title: Choose an image
items.body: Select one image to open the full working area. Sign in with Google before starting AI processing.

items.title: Remove and review
items.body: Start background removal. When the result is ready, inspect the cutout and choose a transparent or solid background.

items.title: Save your finished PNG
items.body: Download the PNG. A selected solid background color is included in the saved image.

items.question: Does the downloaded image include my chosen color?
items.answer: Yes. Selecting a solid background color applies it to the saved PNG. Choose the transparent option if you want a transparent background.

items.question: Where is my image processed?
items.answer: Background removal is a cloud AI feature. The image you choose is uploaded privately for temporary processing; it is not a browser-local operation.

items.question: What happens to my credit if processing fails?
items.answer: The reserved AI credit is refunded when the processing job fails. You can check your balance and credit history in your account.

items.question: Is background removal free?
items.answer: Background removal uses one AI credit per successful job. Your account shows your available balance; local video and image utilities do not use AI credits.
